programme_name: Deep phylogenetic organization of AusTraits lineage-specific trait-memory rankings
question: Are family-specific conservative-to-labile trait-memory rankings more similar between closely related plant families?

family_phylogeny.representative_rule: full GBOTB family crown using all backbone tips in that family
family_phylogeny.distance: patristic distance between family crown representatives

rank_profile_dissimilarity.statistic: Among shared traits, fraction of non-tied unordered trait-pair comparisons whose relative order differs between the two families

association.statistic: Spearman correlation between family patristic distance and rank disagreement
association.null: permute complete observed family rank profiles, including sparse trait coverage, among the fixed family-tree positions

interpretation.positive_on_both_axes: deep phylogenetic continuity of lineage-specific trait rankings
interpretation.weak_or_null_on_both_axes: phylogenetically mosaic re-ranking at family scale
interpretation.axis_sensitive: do not call robust deep inheritance

role: Post-outcome exploratory structure test only; cannot reclassify the prospective AusTraits primary or rank-portability decisions.
